Stripe reported a 38-fold surge in agent purchases through its Link service for agents like Meta's Muse and Grok Bot, mainly in retail and travel, while adding checkout guidance and protections. Network solutions like Mastercard's Agentic Tokens seek better control, but adoption lags, leaving users like Wessman facing murky disputes and broken reward programs as the industry scrambles to align incentives.

stories.title: Trezor Warns CryptoBilis Buyers of Tampered Hardware Wallets
stories.title_en: Trezor Warns CryptoBilis Buyers of Tampered Hardware Wallets
stories.summary: Trezor urges customers who bought any of its hardware wallets from former reseller CryptoBilis since March 2026 to immediately transfer funds to new wallets with fresh recovery seeds. The alert stems from a credible report of a single tampered Safe 5 device purchased in August 2026, featuring an extra circuit board with a cellular module that reads and transmits screen data when plugged in. No fund losses have occurred, and Trezor offers replacements while investigating; it stresses buying from official sources to avoid supply chain risks.

stories.summary: ZeruAI launched delegated wallet connections on its Zaps platform, integrating with Delegate.xyz so users can link a hot wallet to score activity from their offline cold wallet. This solves a key DeFi pain point, rewarding genuine trading and engagement while keeping cold storage secure—users just need to review permissions first. The update fits ZeruAI's shift to Activity Fi, where zScore has already analyzed over 320 million wallets to base rewards on verifiable behavior, not just launch timing. It improves ecosystem attribution as early activity markets like zETH gear up.

stories.title: Crypto Trader Frank Closes Million-Dollar Memecoin Shorts
stories.title_en: Crypto Trader Frank Closes Million-Dollar Memecoin Shorts
stories.summary: Frank, a seasoned crypto trader, shuttered his $12.3 million leveraged short positions on Bitcoin, ZEC, NEAR, and PUMP after booking profits amid a memecoin cooldown. He reflected on the mental strain, noting how holding through drawdowns often earns the 'cancer holder' label, while still believing in the sector's long-term potential but advising against hero plays. The memecoin market has dropped to $30 billion from $150 billion peaks in late 2024, with most tokens crashing 90% or more from highs and rarely recovering, though traders keep hunting for the next big winner amid emotional whiplash.
